# Bust Candidates

**Summary.** In our league, a bust is a price call, not a verdict on the player. The biggest gaps are at the top of the board. Cade Cunningham, Donovan Mitchell, Tyrese Maxey, Jalen Johnson, Cooper Flagg and Tyrese Haliburton are priced like first-rounders, but experts value them from late round one to round two because of crowded usage, shooting and steal regression, or health. Set a stop price for every flagged player before the 2026-10-18 auction and buy only at or below it.

## A bust label is a price

Calling a player a bust does not mean you should never draft him. It means the market is pricing him wrongly. Whether to fade him depends on his price, not on liking or disliking him. The same player can be a fade at a high rank and a fine pick later. So every player line below gives a stop price. At or below that price, he is fine to buy. ([09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=73), [09-29](https://youtu.be/NmdNvAz08oE?t=1586), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1278))

Check which format a label comes from. A bust or sleeper tag from a points league or from ESPN's ranks may not apply to our 9-cat H2H league. Stephon Castle is the clearest case. His points-league hype is far above his category value, because he costs us FT% and TO. Josh Hart is called too high at ESPN and points-league ADP. Bam Adebayo, Anthony Davis and Derrick White are busts only at ESPN's price. At Yahoo-level prices they are fine. ([08-30](https://youtu.be/Alwse2uXzD4?t=2154), [Stephon Castle](../profiles/players/stephon-castle.md), [Josh Hart](../profiles/players/josh-hart.md), [Bam Adebayo](../profiles/players/bam-adebayo.md), [Anthony Davis](../profiles/players/anthony-davis.md), [Derrick White](../profiles/players/derrick-white.md))

The largest gaps sit at the top of the board. Cade Cunningham, Donovan Mitchell, Tyrese Maxey, Jalen Johnson, Cooper Flagg and Tyrese Haliburton are all priced like first-rounders on Yahoo. Experts value each of them lower, from late round one to round two. In a 200 USD auction, paying market price for them leaves less money for the rest of your 12 players. ([Cade Cunningham](../profiles/players/cade-cunningham.md), [Donovan Mitchell](../profiles/players/donovan-mitchell.md), [Tyrese Maxey](../profiles/players/tyrese-maxey.md), [Jalen Johnson](../profiles/players/jalen-johnson.md), [Cooper Flagg](../profiles/players/cooper-flagg.md), [Tyrese Haliburton](../profiles/players/tyrese-haliburton.md))

## Run the prediction game

Before you bid, project a realistic stat line and ask whether it justifies the price. Treat projections as the median outcome. When two players have the same projection, prefer the one with the wider range of outcomes. Veterans like Tobias Harris have no realistic path above their projection, so do not pay for upside they do not have. ([09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1057), [10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=994), [Tobias Harris](../profiles/players/tobias-harris.md))

Mitchell shows how the test works. Experts expect a full year of Harden to cut his usage and assists. They also expect his two-point shooting and steals to regress. Every expert says that line is not a first-rounder, and an expert mock found 31 USD about right. Jalen Johnson is the same story. Take away his expected drop in assists, FG% and steals and you have a mid second-rounder, worth 35 to 40 USD to us. ([09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1057), [Donovan Mitchell](../profiles/players/donovan-mitchell.md), [Jalen Johnson](../profiles/players/jalen-johnson.md))

## Role loss and crowded usage

When a team adds high-usage players, the existing star loses usage and assist upside even if his minutes stay the same. A scorer next to other ball-dominant players also sees his on-ball role shrink. Philadelphia is the clearest case in our data. Maxey, Jaylen Brown and LeBron James share the ball with Embiid, and experts expect Maxey's top-five scoring and Brown's career-high usage to drop. In Cleveland, Mitchell and Harden cut into each other. In Washington, Trae Young shares the ball with Davis and Dybantsa, and Alex Sarr loses usage and rim contests to the same group. ([09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=817), [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=580), [Tyrese Maxey](../profiles/players/tyrese-maxey.md), [Jaylen Brown](../profiles/players/jaylen-brown.md), [LeBron James](../profiles/players/lebron-james.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Trae Young](../profiles/players/trae-young.md), [Alex Sarr](../profiles/players/alex-sarr.md))

Be wary of value that came from teammates being absent. Desmond Bane's rank rests on a role he had while Wagner, Banchero and Suggs were out. Pascal Siakam's assists and usage should drop with Haliburton back. Precious Achiuwa and Ace Bailey posted their late-season numbers while starters sat. Brandin Podziemski is the reverse case. Buy him cheap while Butler is out, and think about selling him before Butler returns. ([09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1494), [Desmond Bane](../profiles/players/desmond-bane.md), [Pascal Siakam](../profiles/players/pascal-siakam.md), [Precious Achiuwa](../profiles/players/precious-achiuwa.md), [Ace Bailey](../profiles/players/ace-bailey.md), [Brandin Podziemski](../profiles/players/brandin-podziemski.md))

Other crowded-usage checks: Davion Mitchell and Andrew Wiggins lose touches next to Giannis. Deni Avdija's usage and assists face Morant and Lillard. Devin Booker's assists depend on whether he or Jalen Green runs the Phoenix offense. ([09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=817), [Davion Mitchell](../profiles/players/davion-mitchell.md), [Andrew Wiggins](../profiles/players/andrew-wiggins.md), [Deni Avdija](../profiles/players/deni-avdija.md), [Devin Booker](../profiles/players/devin-booker.md))

## Shooting and steal regression

When many players on one team have career years at once, expect some of them to regress, often all at the same time. Our data has two such clusters. In Cleveland, Mitchell (two-point %, steals, late FT% spike), Peyton Watson (41% from three) and Jaylon Tyson (about 45% from three) all carry regression flags. In Philadelphia, Maxey (steals rate), Brown (usage and scoring) and Anfernee Simons (rim finishing) carry them too. Do not stack several of these players and count on all the gains holding. ([08-23](https://youtu.be/hm5-fiCa5S4?t=226), [Donovan Mitchell](../profiles/players/donovan-mitchell.md), [Peyton Watson](../profiles/players/peyton-watson.md), [Jaylon Tyson](../profiles/players/jaylon-tyson.md), [Tyrese Maxey](../profiles/players/tyrese-maxey.md), [Jaylen Brown](../profiles/players/jaylen-brown.md), [Anfernee Simons](../profiles/players/anfernee-simons.md))

Small samples and lucky conversions are the other trap. Walker Kessler's gains in threes, steals and assists came from five games. Keegan Murray's 1.6 blocks came from 23 games. Steals built on a high deflection-to-steal rate are flagged for Dejounte Murray, Ayo Dosunmu, Aaron Gordon, Jalen Green and Shaedon Sharpe. Ty Jerome's 70% true shooting and Dosunmu's jump to 44% from three are not expected to repeat. Price these players on the line you expect after regression, not on last season's line. ([09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1057), [Walker Kessler](../profiles/players/walker-kessler.md), [Keegan Murray](../profiles/players/keegan-murray.md), [Dejounte Murray](../profiles/players/dejounte-murray.md), [Ayo Dosunmu](../profiles/players/ayo-dosunmu.md), [Aaron Gordon](../profiles/players/aaron-gordon.md), [Jalen Green](../profiles/players/jalen-green.md), [Shaedon Sharpe](../profiles/players/shaedon-sharpe.md), [Ty Jerome](../profiles/players/ty-jerome.md))

A regression flag is not always a fade. Jamal Murray's three-point shooting should drop toward 40 to 41%, but experts still see a top 12 to 14 finish. Nickeil Alexander-Walker's late shooting run will not hold, yet experts still rate him a top 35 to 50 category player and the market prices him low. Kel'el Ware's 40% from three should drop, but he is still a value bid up to about 13 USD. ([08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1278), [Jamal Murray](../profiles/players/jamal-murray.md), [Nickeil Alexander-Walker](../profiles/players/nickeil-alexander-walker.md), [Kel'el Ware](../profiles/players/kelel-ware.md))

## Age, and where experts split

A player who has been in the league a long time is probably who he is. Do not pay for a breakout or a bounce-back. Players flagged for age decline include Kevin Durant (37), James Harden (37), LeBron James (turning 42), Stephen Curry (38), Anthony Davis (33), Pascal Siakam (32) and Karl-Anthony Towns (30). Build the expected decline and missed games into each stop price. ([07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=837), [10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=994), [Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [LeBron James](../profiles/players/lebron-james.md), [Stephen Curry](../profiles/players/stephen-curry.md), [Anthony Davis](../profiles/players/anthony-davis.md), [Pascal Siakam](../profiles/players/pascal-siakam.md), [Karl-Anthony Towns](../profiles/players/karl-anthony-towns.md))

The experts disagree on how to price older stars with strong per-game lines. One side values the per-game production. Experts put Curry's per-game line near 40 USD, and the category experts agree Durant is a late first-round value. The other side prices in games and minutes. One auction expert caps Curry at 25 USD. In Josh's mock, 40 USD for Durant was already too rich, and Lloyd says Durant's value changes materially if he plays nearer 33 minutes than 35 to 36. For our league, the notes support the middle: the mid to high 20s USD for Curry if you accept 15 to 30 missed games, and the low 40s USD for Durant, never the 50 USD range. ([Stephen Curry](../profiles/players/stephen-curry.md), [Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md))

Age alone does not make a player a bust. Giannis Antetokounmpo carries an age flag, but experts call him a clear top 5 pick in category leagues, and ESPN's rank of 19 is widely called too low. Plan to spend around 60 to 62 USD on him. ([08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1278), [Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md))

## Draft day and in-season checks

Before the auction on 2026-10-18, write down a stop price for each flagged player from the lines below. Stop bidding there, even when the room keeps going. In draft week, check the injury tags: Chet Holmgren's quadriceps, Haliburton's ankle, Kessler's finger and Kyrie Irving's knee. ([09-29](https://youtu.be/NmdNvAz08oE?t=1586), [Chet Holmgren](../profiles/players/chet-holmgren.md), [Tyrese Haliburton](../profiles/players/tyrese-haliburton.md), [Walker Kessler](../profiles/players/walker-kessler.md), [Kyrie Irving](../profiles/players/kyrie-irving.md))

In the first weeks, track the role signals behind each bust call. Check whether Durant plays 35 to 36 minutes or nearer 33. Check Mitchell's assist rate next to Harden, and Maxey's usage with Brown, LeBron and Embiid all healthy. Check Jalen Johnson's assists with McCollum on the floor, and Towns' minutes over the Knicks' cautious first 30 or so games. If the signal confirms the bust, trade him to a manager who still pays for his name. Trades are frequent in our league, and the deadline is 2027-03-04. ([Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md), [Donovan Mitchell](../profiles/players/donovan-mitchell.md), [Tyrese Maxey](../profiles/players/tyrese-maxey.md), [Jalen Johnson](../profiles/players/jalen-johnson.md), [Karl-Anthony Towns](../profiles/players/karl-anthony-towns.md))

Weigh the playoff weeks, which end on 2027-03-28. Cleveland has only two games in our finals week and the most back-to-backs in the league, which hurts Mitchell and Harden late in the season. Miami and Houston play only 10 games across weeks 19 to 21, which trims Giannis, Bam Adebayo and Durant. Haliburton's playoff schedule is only 3-4-3 games. ([Donovan Mitchell](../profiles/players/donovan-mitchell.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md), [Bam Adebayo](../profiles/players/bam-adebayo.md), [Kevin Durant](../profiles/players/kevin-durant.md), [Tyrese Haliburton](../profiles/players/tyrese-haliburton.md))
